new_series.title: The Famous Finish Line
new_series.synopsis: Rick Edwards, Harley Moon Kemp, Mollie Pearce, Molly Rainford and La Voix race in moving podiums across a star-spangled-themed studio to try to win £10,000 for their chosen charity.

new_series.title: Dashcam Justice
new_series.synopsis: A pedestrian hurls himself at a car in pursuit of an insurance payout. A horse rider films a frightening close pass, and a van mounts the pavement, putting bystanders at risk.

new_series.title: Shetland
new_series.synopsis: When human remains are found in a car dredged from the sea, Calder and Tosh must find the troubled owner who fled the Isles nine years ago.

new_series.title: Cunk on Cinema
new_series.synopsis: Philomena Cunk begins her history of cinema, meets the biggest names in Hollywood, and learns the true meaning of The Wizard of Oz.

new_series.title: Artworks
new_series.synopsis: What happens when an artist’s sight begins to disappear? Sociologist Professor Tom Shakespeare explores how sight loss changes the way artists experience the world and create art.

new_series.title: Understand
new_series.synopsis: Ros Atkins investigates how technology is changing what we value, from friendship and culture to finance and work, and asks whether these changes amount to a crisis.

new_series.title: Shadow World
new_series.synopsis: Eight-year-old Sarah Payne vanishes in West Sussex. As the police hunt grows and the world's media descend, her mother Sara refuses to give up hope that she will be found alive.
